name: Mineral Physics & Earth's Deep Interior
summary: The physics of minerals and rocks at high pressure and temperature, and what it reveals about the mantle and core.

topics.name: Equations of state and elasticity of minerals
High-pressure experiments: diamond-anvil cell, multi-anvil press and shock compression
Mantle phase transitions: olivine to wadsleyite, ringwoodite and bridgmanite
Rheology: diffusion creep, dislocation creep and mantle viscosity
Rock physics: porosity, permeability, seismic velocity and attenuation
Composition and structure of the upper mantle, transition zone and lower mantle
The core: composition, light elements, inner-core growth and anisotropy
The core-mantle boundary, D'' layer and large low-shear-velocity provinces
Geochemical reservoirs, mantle mixing and Earth's thermal evolution
